xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3362: No way to seed tracker-backed issue fixtures in workspace containers — every UI-redesign UAT is environment-blocked and needs an operator override

plan.title: Seed tracker-backed issue fixtures into workspace containers for UI UAT
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: Workspace-isolated dashboard containers have no tracker-backed issue data by design (skip-polling IssueDataService serves an empty container-local cache; no project registration), so every UI-redesign browser UAT is environment-blocked and ends in an operator override on diffs nobody doubts (PAN-3356, PAN-2619, PAN-2809 class).
narratives.Proposal: Add `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures <issue-id>`: a host-side command that execs an in-container `--local` seeder in the workspace's server container, writes an obviously-fake fixture set (project `uat-fixtures`/prefix `FIX`/issue `FIX-1`: normalized issue cache row, 5 agent rows incl. review convoy, review_status with PR fields, activity events, xBRIEF spec + continue.json) through the canonical write doors, then restarts the server so skip-polling picks it up. Full design, fixture shapes, and door table in .pan/drafts/PAN-3362.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Fixing GET /api/fs/list-dirs 401 in containers (separate paper cut)
- PAN-2809 node-pty musl/glibc live-terminal Playwright in containers
- Seeding real tracker data or any tracker connection at seed time
- Seeding the host dashboard or any non-container OVERDECK_HOME
- Registering the fixture project on the host or syncing it to any tracker
- Changing deacon/patrol behavior, the single-deacon invariant, or IssueDataService polling
- Per-project application seeds (pan admin db seed covers that)

autoDecisions.summary: CLI command (host wrapper + in-container --local) instead of an HTTP seed endpoint
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requests `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures` next to the existing container recovery commands; an endpoint adds an unauthenticated mutation surface and cannot hide the mandatory server restart.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixtures live only in container-local OVERDECK_HOME with an env-marker guard on --local
autoDecisions.rationale: The container's /home/node/.overdeck is isolated from the host by design; refusing to seed without OVERDECK_DISABLE_DEACON=1/CONTAINER_MODE=1 (unless --force) makes host pollution a deliberate act.

autoDecisions.summary: Host wrapper restarts the server service after seeding
autoDecisions.rationale: skip-polling IssueDataService loads cache.db and the read model once at boot (main.ts:170-173); without a restart the seed is invisible.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixture project key uat-fixtures, prefix FIX, issue FIX-1, no tracker fields
autoDecisions.rationale: Reserved identity plus [FIXTURE] title and uat-fixture label satisfies the issue's obviously-fake constraint; tracker-less config can never be polled or synced.

autoDecisions.summary: No wrapper skill; exclusion-list row in docs/SKILLS-CONVENTION.md
autoDecisions.rationale: Guidance for the non-obvious workflow lives in roles/test.md and docs/WORKSPACE-CONTAINERS.md; --help covers the mechanics, matching the convention's exclusion criteria.

items.title: Fixture data module: builders for the uat-fixtures/FIX-1 fixture set

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/uat-fixtures/fixture-data.ts with pure builder functions for the complete fixture set specified in .pan/drafts/PAN-3362.md (Proposal table + WI-1): fixtureProjectConfig() (ProjectConfig, key uat-fixtures, NO tracker fields, path <OVERDECK_HOME>/uat-fixtures/repo, issue_prefix FIX), fixtureNormalizedIssue() (GitHub cache shape per issue-data-service.ts:~960-994 — id github-uat-fixtures-repo-1, identifier FIX-1, canonicalStatus in_progress, labels [uat-fixture], project {id: github-uat-fixtures-repo}, sourceRepo uat-fixtures/repo, [FIXTURE] title prefix), fixtureAgentStates() (agent-fix-1-work with branch feature/fix-1 plus agent-fix-1-review-{security,correctness,performance,requirements} with reviewSubRole set), fixtureReviewStatus() (reviewStatus approved, testStatus passed, prUrl https://github.com/uat-fixtures/repo/pull/1, prNumber 1, prHeadSha fake), fixtureActivityEntries() (3-4 EmitActivityOptions for FIX-1), fixtureXBriefDoc() (valid xBRIEF v0.8, plan.id fix-1, 3 items with 2 ACs each), fixtureContinueJson(). Export every fixture-identifying literal as a named constant shared by seeder/CLI/tests. Write tests/unit/lib/uat-fixtures/fixture-data.test.ts asserting the shapes and fake markers.

items.title: Given the builders, when tests run, then fixtureNormalizedIssue() returns an object containing identifier 'FIX-1', canonicalStatus, labels including 'uat-fixture', project.id 'github-uat-fixtures-repo', and a title starting with '[FIXTURE]'
fixtureAgentStates() returns 5 AgentState rows: one work row with branch 'feature/fix-1' and four rows named agent-fix-1-review-<role> each carrying reviewSubRole

fixtureXBriefDoc() parses through the repo's xBRIEF reader and contains exactly 3 items each with 2 acceptance-criterion sub-items; fixtureProjectConfig() contains no tracker, github_repo, linear_team, rally_project, or gitlab_repo field
A test asserts no string in any fixture builder output contains 'eltmon/' or a real tracker hostname
Seed writer: seedUatFixturesLocal writes the fixture set through canonical doors

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/uat-fixtures/seed.ts exporting async seedUatFixturesLocal(opts?: { force?: boolean }): Promise<SeedReport> per .pan/drafts/PAN-3362.md WI-2: (1) refuse unless process.env OVERDECK_DISABLE_DEACON==='1' or CONTAINER_MODE==='1' or opts.force, with an error message naming --force; (2) registerProjectSync('uat-fixtures', fixtureProjectConfig()); (3) CacheService.set('github','issues',[fixtureNormalizedIssue()], {ttlSeconds:86400}); (4) saveOverdeckAgentStateSync for each fixtureAgentStates() row; (5) upsertReviewStatusSync(fixtureReviewStatus()); (6) emitActivityEntryDurable for each fixtureActivityEntries() entry; (7) mkdir -p + write spec.vbrief.json and continue.json under <OVERDECK_HOME>/uat-fixtures/repo/workspaces/feature-fix-1/.overdeck/ (derive from OVERDECK_HOME, never hardcode /home/node); (8) return a report (rows written per store + fixture issue id). NO raw SQL — only the named doors. Tests in tests/unit/lib/uat-fixtures/seed.test.ts use setupOverdeckTestDb() with a temp OVERDECK_HOME and fake env: seeding populates 5 agent rows, 1 review_status row with PR fields, readable activity events, both plan files; guard refusal without env markers; force override; idempotent re-run leaves identical row counts.

items.title: Given a temp OVERDECK_HOME with container env markers set, when seedUatFixturesLocal() runs, then the agents table returns 5 rows for FIX-1, review_status returns 1 row with pr_url/pr_number/pr_head_sha set, and activity events for FIX-1 are readable back
When OVERDECK_DISABLE_DEACON and CONTAINER_MODE are both unset, seedUatFixturesLocal() rejects with an error naming '--force', and succeeds when force: true is passed
When called twice against the same OVERDECK_HOME, the second call leaves identical row counts in agents, review_status, and api_cache (idempotent upsert)
Seeding persists spec.vbrief.json and continue.json under <OVERDECK_HOME>/uat-fixtures/repo/workspaces/feature-fix-1/.overdeck/ and the persisted spec passes the repo's plan reader
CLI: pan admin seed-uat-fixtures with host wrapper and --local modes

verify_commands: npm run build && node dist/cli/index.js admin seed-uat-fixtures --help
expected_outputs: --help prints usage for <issue-id> host mode and --local/--force flags

narrative.Action: Create src/cli/commands/admin/seed-uat-fixtures.ts and register it in src/cli/commands/admin/index.ts following the existing one-file-per-subcommand pattern (see src/cli/commands/admin/state-migrate.ts). Spec per .pan/drafts/PAN-3362.md WI-3: `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures <issue-id>` (host mode) resolves the workspace compose stack (project name overdeck-feature-<issue-lower>; reuse the compose resolution helper that `pan workspace rebuild` uses — locate via `grep -rn rebuildWorkspaceStack src/lib`), refuses with a clear error when no stack exists, runs `docker compose -p overdeck-feature-<issue-lower> exec -T server node dist/cli/index.js admin seed-uat-fixtures --local`, then `docker compose -p … restart server`, then polls the server health endpoint (https://api-feature-<issue-lower>.overdeck.localhost/api/health) until 200 or 60s timeout, and prints the seed report plus the dashboard URL. `--local [--force]` calls seedUatFixturesLocal({force}) and prints the report. Use execAsync/spawn, never execSync.

items.title: node dist/cli/index.js admin seed-uat-fixtures --help exits 0 and prints usage covering the <issue-id> positional and the --local/--force flags

Given this issue's own workspace stack is running, when `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures pan-3362` completes, then it exits 0 after restarting the server, and the container dashboard at https://feature-pan-3362.overdeck.localhost renders FIX-1's issue detail with a phase, branch feature/fix-1, a PR link, four review-convoy rows, a Plan tab with a non-zero item badge, and a non-empty Activity feed (browser UAT for this issue)
When the named issue has no running compose stack, host mode exits non-zero with an error naming the expected compose project and how to start the stack
When run twice against the same stack, the second run exits 0 and the container dashboard still renders exactly one FIX-1 issue
Docs: WORKSPACE-CONTAINERS seeding section, test-role guidance, skills exclusion row

narrative.Action: Update the three docs per .pan/drafts/PAN-3362.md WI-4: (1) docs/WORKSPACE-CONTAINERS.md gains a 'Seeding UAT issue fixtures' section next to the recovery commands (~line 109-119) covering both modes, the restart behavior, the ephemeral-across-recreate caveat (re-seed after up --force-recreate), and the obviously-fake contract (never register a real FIX project); (2) roles/test.md extends the container rule at line 64 so test agents run `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures <issue-id>` and UAT against FIX-1 before declaring an environment-blocked UI UAT — only a seeding failure itself is environment-blocked; (3) docs/SKILLS-CONVENTION.md exclusion table gains a `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures` row (rationale: guidance lives in roles/test.md + WORKSPACE-CONTAINERS.md; --help covers mechanics).

items.title: docs/WORKSPACE-CONTAINERS.md contains a 'Seeding UAT issue fixtures' section that names `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures`, the --local mode, the server-restart requirement, and the re-seed-after-recreate caveat
roles/test.md names `pan admin seed-uat-fixtures` in its container-UAT guidance and states that a UI UAT may be declared environment-blocked only when seeding itself fails
